Job Title:

Senior Mission Designer - STARCRAFT | Irvine, CA, CA

Requisition ID:

R028111

Job Description:

Your Mission

Blizzard Entertainment is assembling a team to build the next chapter of STARCRAFT, returning to a universe forged in interstellar war. This mission offers something new: crafting an original story-driven, open-world shooter while honoring the legacy of one of Blizzard's most beloved games.

We are here to reignite this universe alongside you. We are here to make STARCRAFT, and it's about damn time.

We are looking for a Senior Mission Designer to help craft this new game for Blizzard. As a key member of the development team, you will be responsible for delivering. You have proven experience working in a team dynamic and are comfortable building missions from concept to ship, looking at everything from dialogue to layout composition and combat encounters. When particularly hard problems arise, you will draw upon the team's collective creativity and experience to finalize designs that meet the needs of the game. You will collaborate with an experienced team at a fast pace with a highly iterative feedback process.

This role offers a hybrid work week, with a mix of work-from-home and on-site days, based out of our Irvine studio.

Responsibilities

Priorities can often change in a fast-paced environment like ours, so this role includes, but is not limited to the following responsibilities:

•

Design and build captivating layouts and locations that align with the game’s narrative and gameplay goals.

•

Integrate gameplay mechanics, challenges, combat, and puzzles into mission designs to enhance player engagement and exploration.

•

Collaborate with other designers, artists, code, audio, VFX, and animation departments to a compelling holistic player experience.

•

Deliver high-quality results and build progress towards short- to medium- to long-term deliverables/releases, from iterative prototyping to execution.

•

Prototype and create engaging missions or mission components in-engine to a AAA standard that integrate player fantasy, narrative, and gameplay.

Requirements

•

8+ years of experience creating missions/quests, layout, and the frameworks that missions are built from, or combination of related education and experience.

•

Experience with technical design, scripting, and level design.

•

Proven experience shipping AAA titles.

•

Experience working with cross-functional teams in feature development.

•

A professional understanding and competency for the Unreal engine.

•

Proven spatial and layout design skills on a shipped title.

•

A team-oriented approach to your work, understanding the importance of collaboration, and partnering with all departments.

Extra Points:

•

Multiple AAA shipped titles.

•

Experience working with large cross discipline teams.

•

Familiarity with programming and scripting languages such as C++, C#, Lua, or JavaScript

•

A deep understanding of Open World and narrative driven games.

•

Highly skilled in using Unreal Blueprint.

Your Platform

Best known for iconic video game universes including Warcraft®, Overwatch®, Diablo®, and StarCraft®, Blizzard Entertainment, Inc. (www.blizzard.com), a division of Activision Blizzard, which was acquired by Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), is a premier developer and publisher of entertainment experiences. Blizzard Entertainment has created some of the industry’s most critically acclaimed and genre-defining games over the last 30 years, with a track record that includes multiple Game of the Year awards. Blizzard Entertainment engages tens of millions of players around the world with titles available on PC via Battle.net®, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android.

Our World

Activision Blizzard, Inc., is one of the world's largest and most successful interactive entertainment companies and is at the intersection of media, technology and entertainment. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, World of Warcraft®, Overwatch®, Diablo®, Candy Crush™ and Bubble Witch™. Our combined entertainment network delights hundreds of millions of monthly active users in 196 countries, making us the largest gaming network on the planet!

Our ability to build immersive and innovative worlds is only enhanced by diverse teams working in an inclusive environment. We aspire to have a culture where everyone can thrive in order to connect and engage the world through epic entertainment. We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered!

The video game industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners

We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all the qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.

We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to accommodationrequests@activisionblizzard.com. General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics.

Rewards

We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

• Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance;
• 401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching;

About the Team

The Finance Platform & Technology team builds and scales the systems and data architecture that power OpenAI’s core financial operations. We enable business agility, compliance, and operational excellence across procure-to-pay, quote-to-cash, supply chain, financial planning, and asset management. We partner with Procurement, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Security, Data, and Engineering to modernize workflows through thoughtful platform design, reliable integrations, scalable automation, and trusted data.

About the Role

As a Business Systems Lead for Procure-to-Pay, you will be a hands-on engineer who designs, builds, and operates the integrations and first-party applications that power OpenAI’s procurement workflows. You will translate business needs into secure, scalable software, APIs, data flows, and automation across Oracle Fusion, Zip, and connected platforms.

You will build the future of buying at OpenAI using OpenAI’s own technology, from guided intake and approval experiences to supplier onboarding, purchasing, receiving, invoicing, and downstream financial data flows. You will own the technical roadmap and support model for these capabilities, improving today’s platforms while deciding where to integrate, configure, or build as OpenAI scales.

Your core strength will be software and integration engineering. You will personally write code, troubleshoot cross-system failures, and take solutions through testing, deployment, and production support. You will also make targeted functional configurations in procurement platforms and partner with functional specialists on deeper process and module design.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Design, build, and operate integrations across Oracle Fusion, Zip, and connected systems using APIs, events, messaging, and batch interfaces where appropriate.

- Build first-party procurement applications, backend services, and user-facing workflows that simplify intake, approvals, transaction visibility, and exception resolution.

- Write maintainable code and reusable integration components, with version control, code review, automated tests, and repeatable deployment and rollback practices.

- Define data contracts, mappings, durable identifiers, lifecycle states, and authoritative data ownership so transactions remain accurate and traceable across systems.

- Engineer reliable processing through validation, idempotency, retries, monitoring, alerting, reconciliation, recovery, and readback from the system of record.

- Build and evaluate AI-enabled workflows using OpenAI technology, with scoped tool access, explicit approval boundaries, audit trails, and safe handling of errors or uncertain outputs.

- Make targeted Oracle Fusion and Zip configuration changes that support delivered workflows, such as intake fields, routing, approvals, and supplier settings, in partnership with Procurement, AP, and functional specialists.

- Own technical testing and release readiness, including integration and regression tests, business UAT, migration validation, staged rollout, and operational documentation.

- Own the long-term procurement applications and integrations roadmap, prioritizing reusable capabilities and making clear build-versus-configure decisions with business and engineering partners.

- Own production health and incident resolution, protect access and financial controls, and deliver durable fixes that reduce failed transactions, manual intervention, and procurement cycle time.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have 6+ years of experience in enterprise integrations, software engineering, or business systems engineering, with substantial hands-on responsibility for building and operating production solutions.

- Can personally write, review, test, and debug production code in a language such as Python or TypeScript, and use SQL to investigate data quality, reconcile systems, and validate outcomes.

- Have hands-on experience integrating with Oracle Fusion and understanding how Procurement and Payables transactions move through its APIs, data models, and interfaces.

- Have designed and shipped APIs, services, or internal applications, and can explain your implementation choices, failure modes, and results in production.

- Understand REST APIs, JSON, authentication and authorization, data modeling, and event-driven or message-based integration patterns.

- Have built and operated integrations using OIC, Workato, or comparable platforms, and can choose when custom code, native APIs, or an integration platform best fits the problem.

- Have owned production troubleshooting and service reliability, including observability, retries, reconciliation, incident response, and safe recovery.

- Understand the P2P lifecycle and how approvals, supplier data, purchase orders, receiving, matching, invoices, and payments affect downstream accounting and controls.

- Can make targeted functional configuration changes and validate their business impact, while partnering with specialists for deeper module design. Experience with Zip is a plus.

- Apply secure engineering and financial-control practices, including least-privilege access, segregation of duties, sensitive-change approvals, and auditable transaction histories.

- Communicate clearly with Procurement, AP, Accounting, Risk, and Engineering, turn ambiguous needs into working software, and bring curiosity about building and evaluating AI-enabled applications.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. This position has multiple openings and will be based in our Washington, D.C. (Midtown Center) office.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Governments do some of the most consequential work there is: deciding benefits claims, getting veterans to care, investigating financial misconduct, running unemployment insurance, and producing the analysis that world leaders act on. Anthropic's public sector team exists to put Claude in the production path of that work. In the US and some allied governments, Claude is already in daily use across major agencies and US states.

The next steps need a particular kind of product manager: someone who can walk into an institution they have never worked with, sit with the people doing the work and find, alongside them, the workflow that matters. The best government products we know of started as an idea that came out of the room rather than a requirements document.

The scope is large: a product portfolio here is a set of governments rather than a feature area. A year in, success looks like agencies delivering services more effectively because public servants are doing core parts of their job with Claude in the loop, and at least one thing that you learn from them shipping to every Anthropic enterprise. That is a lot of surface; you will have to choose where to go deep, and we will back the choice.

We are hiring across civilian, state and local, govtech, and national security portfolios and will match you to one on background and interest. Some portfolios require eligibility for a US security clearance, though most do not. You would be among the first product managers on the team, working with a dedicated engineering and research team and with the policy, go-to-market, customer success, and applied AI leads who already spend their days inside these agencies.

In this role, you will:

• Alongside GTM, run discovery inside government institutions to find where Claude belongs in the production path of their work, then shape the product around what you find
• Own product decisions for our government models and product offerings and the agency workflows built on top of them
• Spot the government needs worth generalizing and carry them into Anthropic's broader roadmap. Many of Anthropic’s commercial features started as public-sector customer problems
• Help Anthropic navigate government compliance regimes
• Partner with our cloud and integration partners

You may be a good fit if you:

• Have shipped successful products end-to-end. We weigh product judgment above any domain credential
• Can point to something you built that was your idea: it came from watching people work rather than from a requirements document
• Get things done through teams that don't report to you. In addition to the dedicated team, this role runs through a variety of partner teams inside Anthropic and many offices inside each agency.
• Move on your own clock. You have shipped in an organization with a fast cadence, or you set the pace in an environment that didn't
• Have built domain intuition fast in large enterprises that do not resemble each other
• Are a US person. We have agreements with the US Government that mandate this for these roles.

Strong candidates may also have:

• Roughly 7+ years building and shipping products, or equivalent scope
• Real intuition for how government operates, earned either from the inside or at a digital services organization or by building products public servants actually use
• Taken a public-sector or field requirement into a commercial product that succeeded
• Fluency with AI products: evaluations, model behavior as part of the product surface
• Shipped inside a FedRAMP, classified, or comparable compliance boundary
• Negotiated with or steered large partners such as cloud providers or systems integrators
• An active TS/SCI security clearance with the US government (relevant for only some roles)
• Ability to travel up to 25% of the time

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$305,000—$385,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

JOB OVERVIEW

The Learning & Development Manager is the learning business partner for the Global India Center (GIC). The role works with business leaders and HRBPs to understand learning needs, and then plans, coordinates and runs the learning programs that meet them at a GIC level.

The role is function-agnostic, covering leadership and professional development, core enterprise capabilities, and skills that support the GIC as it grows. The focus is on getting learning delivered well, on time, with strong participation and clear evidence of what it achieved.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Business Partnering

• Work with business leaders and HRBPs to understand team-level learning needs and translate them into specific program requirements.
• Run regular check-ins with stakeholder groups to keep the learning plan current and gather feedback on what is working.
• Act as the single point of contact for the business on learning requests, timelines and escalations.

Program Planning and Coordination

• Propose and execute the annual learning plan for the GIC, including priorities, sequencing and resourcing, for sign-off by the Head of Learning, Change and Comms.
• Manage the learning budget, track spend against plan, and flag variances.
• Coordinate nominations, scheduling, logistics, venues and facilitator bookings across programs.

Solution Build and Delivery

• Work with Learning Architects and the global Learning COE to adapt enterprise learning journeys and academies for the GIC.
• Contract and manage SMEs, vendors and external facilitators, including scoping, quality checks and performance reviews.
• Facilitate or co-facilitate sessions where required.
• Make sure learning is practical and usable in the flow of work, using digital, AI-enabled and blended formats where they fit.

Rollout and Adoption

• Run the rollout of learning programs across the GIC, including nomination drives, manager briefings and reminders.
• Partner with the Internal Communications team on campaign plans and messaging for each program.
• Track attendance and completion, follow up on drop-offs, and keep leaders informed on their teams' participation.

LMS, Data and Reporting

• Own the content governance framework for the Learning Management System (LMS), keeping materials accurate, current and aligned to enterprise standards.
• Maintain learning dashboards and produce regular reporting on participation, completion, feedback scores and cost.
• Review the data to spot what needs fixing, and act on it.
• Write up impact stories and case studies that show what programs delivered.

Team and Ways of Working

• Manage and develop the Learning Operations team member, setting clear priorities, standards and development goals.
• Keep processes, templates and documentation in good order so delivery is consistent and repeatable.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATION

• 10 to 12 years of experience in Learning, Talent Development or HR, with hands-on program delivery experience
• Strong background in leadership development and enterprise capability building
• Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across stakeholders
• Track record of planning and running learning programs end to end, at scale
• Experience managing vendors, facilitators and budgets
• Experience working in complex, global, matrixed environments
• Comfort using digital, AI-enabled and modern learning formats
• Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION

• Comfortable with LMS platforms, learning data and reporting
• Strong execution and follow-through
• Organised, with attention to detail across many moving parts
• Stakeholder management and clear communication
• Facilitation skills
• Data literacy and a practical improvement mindset
• Comfort working at pace and adapting when plans change

jobs.description: アマゾンジャパンAmazon Logistics(以下、AMZL)部門のセントラルオペレーションチームでは急速に拡大している物流の最後の区間、ラストマイルネットワークを円滑に運営するために注文数の予測や配送ドライバー台数の計画、運用方法を改革していくことを目指したオペレーションを構築します。そのため、イノベーションと問題解決に情熱を持ち、世界最高レベルの顧客体験を創造する能力を持つLogistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーターを募集しています。日本にある全てのAMZLデリバリーステーション(以下、DS)をサポートする重要な役割を担っていただきます。 勤務形態は40時間/週、日勤・夜勤8時間勤務のシフト制(土日祝日含む)となります。シフトにより年末年始の勤務あり。 関連情報 ・所属部門: ラストマイル(AMZL) ・職種: オペレーション https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp Key job responsibilities 全国のDSの配送オペレーションを横断的にサポートしていただく役割を担って頂きます。支える役割を担っていただきます。具体的には荷物量の予測からドライバーの配車計画、配送ルート作成、当日のリアルタイム対応まで、マネージャーやチームと連携しながら以下の業務を遂行します： 1. 配送計画の策定・調整: 全国のDSに対し、日次の荷物量予測に基づきドライバー台数・配送ルートを計画し、リアルタイムで最適化する 2. オペレーション異常への即時対応: 遅延・災害等の発生時に、配送ルート再編成やステークホルダーへの情報共有を迅速に実施し、配送サービス・納期を維持する 3. パフォーマンスの可視化・報告: 日次・週次のオペレーションレポートを作成し、改善機会をマネージャーに提案する 4. オペレーション拡大時の準備・実行: セールイベントや新規サービス・システム導入時に、手順変更の検討・標準作業手順書（SOP）の作成・トレーニング教材の構築を行い、円滑な導入を推進する 5. 業務標準化・改善の推進: チームメンバーとステークスホルダーと協力し、データに基づいた業務プロセスの改善と標準化を推進する A day in the life あなたの1日は、全国のDS状況をリアルタイムで把握することから始まります。シフト開始時に朝礼を行い、当日の業務内容を確認します。配送計画、リアルタイム対応、改善推進など、専門チームごとに担当領域が分かれており、あなたの強みや適性に応じたチームに配属されます。 シフト中は、複数のモニターで状況を監視しながら、配送計画の策定・調整業務を行います。突発的な遅延や天候変化に対応する場面もあります。あなたが支えるのは、デリバリーステーションに荷物が届く前からお客様の手元に届くまでの全プロセスです。1人で判断するのではなく、チームメンバーと連携しながらリアルタイムで最適な解決策を見つけていきます。 また、日々のオペレーション対応だけでなく、「もっとこうすれば効率的になるのでは？」というアイデアをチームに提案し、改善プロジェクトを主動していただきます。前職での経験や視点を活かして、新しい仕組みづくりに貢献できる環境です。 About the team ■セントラルオペレーション■ セントラルオペレーションは複数のチームからなる300人を超える大規模な組織です。大多数は日本語を母語とするメンバーですが、多様なバックグラウンドを持つメンバーが世界中から集まっています。多様性(DEI)が尊重され、安心して働ける環境です。 ■会社のカルチャー■ Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており、仕事とプライベートの両方を充実させることができます。 まずは試してみることを大切にしています。好奇心を持って学び、時にはリスクを取りながら、よりよい成果に繋げていく文化があります。 ■キャリアパス■ Logistics Scheduler/物流コーディネーターからキャリアをスタートし、チームのマネージャーとなった実績も多数あります。また、社内公募制度を通じて、国内外の他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

Shape the data platform behind enterprise-scale network security. Palo Alto Networks is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy and roadmap for Strata Logging Service and the data platform capabilities supporting Strata Cloud Manager.

The scope spans high-volume log and telemetry ingestion, real-time streaming and processing, data lake storage, retention, and forwarding—foundational capabilities that support security visibility, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled automation.

Working at the intersection of customer needs and platform architecture, this product manager partners closely with engineering to define requirements and evaluate tradeoffs across throughput, latency, data freshness, reliability, and cloud infrastructure economics. Ownership includes a three-to-five-year platform vision, a phased execution roadmap, and measurable customer and business outcomes.

Success requires demonstrated technical product management experience with logging, observability, streaming data, or comparable distributed data platforms, combined with enterprise customer judgment and the ability to lead complex initiatives from discovery through launch and adoption.

This position is based at Palo Alto Networks headquarters in Santa Clara, California, with a hybrid schedule requiring three days onsite per week.

Your Impact

• Own the product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for Strata Logging Service and related logging and telemetry platform capabilities.
• Define requirements for real-time ingestion, streaming data processing, storage, retention, and forwarding of network and security data.
• Partner with engineering on platform tradeoffs involving ingestion throughput, end-to-end latency, data freshness, durability, availability, and infrastructure cost.
• Define customer requirements for data onboarding, supported sources, schema evolution, data quality, delivery failures, and recovery.
• Develop a three-to-five-year platform vision and translate it into prioritized, achievable roadmap increments.
• Engage enterprise customers, network and security administrators, partners, and field teams to understand operational workflows and unmet needs.
• Translate customer problems into product requirements, acceptance criteria, and measurable success metrics.
• Establish platform metrics covering ingestion success, throughput, latency, reliability, customer adoption, and cost efficiency.
• Support growing data volumes and multi-tenant SaaS requirements while balancing performance, reliability, and cloud economics.
• Partner across product teams to support logging, telemetry, and visibility requirements for new network security capabilities.
• Identify AI-enabled analytics and automation opportunities grounded in customer problems and the platform’s data capabilities.
• Lead capabilities from discovery through launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
• Partner with UX and engineering to deliver intuitive platform experiences that simplify the work of network and security administrators.
• Conduct market research and competitive analysis to inform product strategy and identify emerging customer needs.
• Partner with product marketing, technical marketing, sales engineering, and support on positioning, enablement, beta programs, and customer escalations.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

• 10+ years of product management experience, including ownership of technical enterprise software, SaaS, or cloud platform products.
• Demonstrated product ownership of a logging, telemetry, observability, streaming data, security data, or comparable high-volume data platform.
• Experience defining requirements for real-time or near-real-time data ingestion and processing, together with downstream storage or data delivery.
• Ability to discuss technical tradeoffs involving distributed data pipelines, throughput, latency, schema evolution, retention, reliability, and cost with engineering teams.
• Experience defining long-term product strategy and translating it into phased roadmaps, clear priorities, and measurable outcomes.
• Demonstrated ownership of product discovery, requirements, prioritization, delivery, launch, and adoption.
• Experience working directly with enterprise customers and translating complex operational needs into platform capabilities.
• Experience using customer feedback, usage data, and platform performance metrics to guide product decisions.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams while managing multiple priorities.
• Strong analytical, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders.
• Bachelor’s or master’s degree, equivalent practical experience, or equivalent military experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with network security, network management, next-generation firewalls, or security operations products.
• Product experience with log management, security information and event management (SIEM), security analytics, or observability platforms.
• Familiarity with event-streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, or comparable systems.
• Experience with data lake architectures, high-volume telemetry storage, and the relationship between streaming pipelines and downstream analytics.
• Experience defining log forwarding, external integrations, APIs, or data export capabilities.
• Experience optimizing cloud infrastructure economics, including compute, storage, retention, and data transfer costs.
• Experience with data governance, access controls, tenant isolation, or compliance requirements for enterprise data platforms.
• Experience developing AI-enabled analytics, automation, or intelligent operational workflows.
• Experience working with enterprise customers, partners, sales engineering, technical marketing, and technical support organizations.

Compensation Disclosure

For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$153,000.00 - $247,500.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

jobs.description: A Prudential é uma empresa global de 150 anos de história com presença em mais de 50 países e estamos há mais de 27 anos ajudando a minimizar o impacto financeiro que um imprevisto pode representar na vida de milhares de famílias brasileiras. Somos a maior seguradora independente no segmento de vida e tivemos uma média de crescimento de 27% de faturamento no país nos últimos 10 anos. Com crescimento sólido, reputação global e líder de mercado, nos dedicamos a oferecer soluções inovadoras e personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para nossos clientes. -- MOVIDOS POR PROTEGER, INSPIRADOS POR PESSOAS Aqui na Prudential, oferecemos soluções personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para milhões de brasileiros. Nosso propósito e crescimento acelerado nos posicionaram como a maior seguradora independente no segmento de pessoas (excluindo VGBL). É com muito orgulho que alcançamos mais de 5 milhões de vidas protegidas no Brasil. Com 150 anos de atuação no mundo, a Prudential tem operações nos Estados Unidos, Ásia, Europa e América Latina. A Prudential do Brasil é um lugar para realizar em meio a um time que valoriza a colaboração. Se nosso símbolo é o rochedo, a nossa força são nossas pessoas, suas histórias e seu repertório. Conheça um pouco mais sobre nós clicando aqui. SOBRE A POSIÇÃO Estamos em busca de um(a) Atuário(a) Júnior para integrar nossa equipe de Reservas, uma área estratégica que exerce papel fundamental na sustentabilidade financeira da companhia e no cumprimento das exigências regulatórias do mercado segurador. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico, participando de análises atuariais, cálculos de provisões, reportes regulatórios e iniciativas de melhoria contínua. Além disso, trabalhará em parceria com diversas áreas da companhia, contribuindo para processos que impactam diretamente os resultados do negócio. Se você gosta de números, análises, desafios técnicos e busca uma oportunidade de desenvolvimento em uma das áreas mais estratégicas do mercado segurador, essa vaga pode ser para você. RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES Como será seu dia a dia: Apoiar os processos de cálculo e acompanhamento das provisões técnicas da companhia. Participar da elaboração, validação e envio de reportes regulatórios obrigatórios para a SUSEP. Realizar análises e validações de informações utilizadas nos cálculos atuariais. Apoiar as atividades de fechamento mensal da área de Reservas. Trabalhar com bases de dados operacionais relacionadas a prêmios, sinistros e provisões técnicas. Contribuir para a identificação e tratamento de inconsistências de dados e processos. Participar de projetos de automação e melhoria contínua das rotinas atuariais. Apoiar a revisão e evolução dos processos internos da área, buscando ganhos de eficiência e redução de atividades manuais. Interagir constantemente com áreas como Controladoria, Tecnologia, Sinistros, Benefícios e parceiros externos. Colaborar na construção de análises e materiais que apoiem a tomada de decisão do time e da liderança. REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES Do que você precisa: Formação superior completa em Ciências Atuariais Excel avançado. Forte capacidade analítica e raciocínio lógico. Facilidade para trabalhar com dados, números e análises quantitativas. Organização e atenção aos detalhes. Boa comunicação verbal e escrita. Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas e prazos simultaneamente. Interesse em desenvolver conhecimento técnico em provisões, regulamentação e mercado segurador. Buscamos alguém que tenha experiência em... Atuação em áreas atuariais ou analíticas. Manipulação e análise de dados. Rotinas estruturadas que exigem alto nível de organização e precisão. Ambientes com controles, processos e cumprimento de prazos. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Conhecimento em Reservas Atuariais. Vivência com provisões técnicas. Conhecimento de regulamentações da SUSEP. Conhecimento em SAS. Experiência com automação de processos. Vivência em mercado segurador ou financeiro. O QUE BUSCAMOS NESTE PROFISSIONAL Mais do que experiência técnica, buscamos uma pessoa que tenha potencial de crescimento e vontade de aprender. Procuramos profissionais que: Tenham perfil organizado e disciplinado. Gostem de resolver problemas e investigar causas. Demonstrem senso de responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes. Possuam boa comunicação e facilidade de relacionamento com diferentes áreas. Tenham curiosidade para aprender novas ferramentas e formas de automatizar processos. Apresentem postura colaborativa e espírito de equipe. Consigam atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com prazos regulatórios rigorosos. Demonstrem autonomia, protagonismo e disposição para buscar soluções. Aqui você tem flexibilidade com nosso modelo de trabalho híbrido (3x2). Essa posição será baseada em no Rio de Janeiro. NA PRUDENTIAL, VOCÊ PODE CONTAR COM: • Assistência médica e odontológica • Vale refeição e vale alimentação • Seguro de Vida em Grupo Prudential • Participação nos lucros • Previdência privada com 100% de complementaridade • Auxílio creche ou babá • Programa de compra de ações • Auxílio Funeral, incluindo cônjuge, filhos, pais e sogros • Plataforma de desenvolvimento CUIDAMOS TAMBÉM DO SEU BEM-ESTAR O Viver Bem é o principal programa de saúde e bem-estar da Prudential, abrangendo as dimensões física, mental e financeira. • Horário flexível • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida • Wellhub • Incentivo financeiro às práticas de atividades físicas • Espaço Viver Bem • Day off de aniversário • Programa de Reconhecimento por Tempo de Casa • Viver Bem+ • Campanha de vacinação nos escritórios • Programa de apoio ao colaborador e seus dependentes com aconselhamento financeiro, jurídico e psicológico Quer conhecer mais sobre a Prudential do Brasil? Visite: Prudential do Brasil Na Prudential, acreditamos que uma empresa é feita pelo potencial que cada pessoa traz para construir, inovar e colaborar. Por isso, incentivamos o protagonismo, o aprendizado contínuo e a excelência em cada entrega, criando um ambiente onde as pessoas podem desenvolver suas carreiras e gerar impacto positivo. Reconhecemos e valorizamos quem faz a diferença, oferecendo iniciativas voltadas ao desenvolvimento profissional, ao bem-estar e à qualidade de vida. Somos uma empresa inclusiva que valoriza a diversidade em nossos processos seletivos e no dia a dia, respeitando e acolhendo cada indivíduo em sua singularidade. Consideramos e valorizamos todas as características pessoais, como raça, etnia, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência, estado civil, idade, geração, crença, localidade e qualquer outro marcador social.
